cmp.down: {{n}} learners wrote both. The average went from {{avgA}}% in the {{a}} to {{avgB}}% in the {{b}} (−{{change}} points).
cmp.strongLink: Learners who did well in the {{a}} mostly did well in the {{b}} too — the first test is a good early signal.
cmp.someLink: Learners who did well in the {{a}} tended to do well in the {{b}}, but not always.
cmp.weakLink: The {{a}} score says little about the {{b}} score — they test different things.
cmp.passedAOnly: {{n}} learners passed the {{a}} but not the {{b}} — they may need support before selection.
cmp.passedBOnly: {{n}} learners failed the {{a}} but passed the {{b}} — the add-on videos may have helped them.
